thread:
incident-bot: Pager: dedicated-resv-pool resv-us-east-3 - GPU utilization 98%, queue length spiking, autoscaler errors (rate_limit_exceeded). Potential customer impact for customers with reserved capacity. Severity: P1. Link: https://dash.redwood.internal/pools/resv-us-east-3/metrics
Maria G.: I'm on it. paging Sam H. (oncall). Oncall bridge?
Sam H.: here, pinged bridge. joining in 30s. What's the immediate customer impact?
Arjun P.: seeing sustained queue growth on the podset handling reserved workloads. Backpressure started ~00:12 UTC. Some requests are being throttled with 429 from router.
Joel: logs from the autoscaler show repeated 429 from quota API while attempting to request extra GPUs: `error: quota.rate_limit_exceeded, retry_after=10s`
Kevin (CS): I already got a ping from a customer (OrchidBank). They report timeouts and degraded latencies for long-running chat sessions. They're in reserved pool resv-us-east-3.
Sam H.: ok first actions: 1) surface top impacted tenants 2) raise autoscale max temporarily 3) enable eviction policy for best-effort sessions 4) open customer bridge if Orchid asks
Maria G.: surface impacted tenants: running query now ->
```
SELECT tenant, count(*) as queued FROM requests
WHERE pool = 'resv-us-east-3' AND state='queued'
GROUP BY tenant ORDER BY queued DESC LIMIT 10;
```
Maria G.: top tenants: orchidbank (4.3k queued), greenfield-pay (1.1k), internal-evals (700). Orchid is top and has reserved capacity.
Sam H.: can we spin up a hot spare in us-east-3 dedicated ephemeral? autoscaler failed earlier due to rate limits but manual scale should work.
Arjun P.: trying manual add: `infra scale-pool resv-us-east-3 --gpus 4 --force` -> deploy-bot returns: `quota.limit_reached`
deploy-bot: deploy action rejected: account quota cap for region us-east-3 reached. Contact quota team or shift workloads.
Joel: this smells like noisy neighbor. Orchid is using long sessions with heavy batching. We can try preempting best-effort queues first.
Sam H.: Maria/Arjun, can you enable `evict.best_effort=true` on the pool so preemptible sessions drop? That should free GPU memory/KV cache and reduce queue length.
Maria G.: enabling now: `curl -XPOST https://api.redwood.internal/pools/resv-us-east-3/config -d '{"evict_best_effort":true}'` -> 200 OK
Maria G.: eviction triggered, dropping ~900 best-effort sessions. Queue dropped ~12% in the first 60s.
Kevin (CS): I told Orchid CS lead we saw throttling and that we're triaging. They want ETA. Any estimate?
Sam H.: short ETA: 15-25m to stabilize if no other limits hit. If quota block persists we'll need regional shift.
Arjun P.: autoscaler still spiking errors when reconciling; digging into the quota handshake. Looks like our account-level GPU quota for the region is at limit because of another reserved pool allocated for a partner. Raising request to infra-quota now.
Joel: alternative mitigation: soft-fallback routing - route Orchid's new sessions to hosted models (not reserved) with explicit opt-in. That preserves service (lower model size) while we fix capacity. Risk: data residency and SLA differences.
Kevin (CS): Orchid is enterprise - they signed reserved capacity for performance and data isolation. Hosted fallback will need CS + legal signoff. They asked for status not workaround.
Sam H.: understood. For now keep CS updated and prioritize freeing reserved capacity. Maria, can we temporarily increase eviction aggressiveness for long-idle KV caches?
Maria G.: bumping `evict.age_threshold` from 30m to 5m. Applying patch... applied. Should free caches within 2-3 min.
Sam H.: good. Also disable internal-evals background jobs hitting the pool. Arjun, can you toggle that?
Arjun P.: disabling scheduler job `internal-evals-resv-us-east-3` -> done. That freed ~700 queued tasks. Queue down ~20% more.
Kevin (CS): Orchid asked for above actions log and whether their SLA will be affected. I'll tell them we're applying targeted evictions and reducing background load; still monitoring.
deploy-bot: audit-log: `config_change by Maria G. evict_best_effort=true; evict.age_threshold=5m; scheduler.disabled=internal-evals-resv-us-east-3`
Sam H.: still seeing a tail of long KV sessions pinned by Orchid long-polls. Maria, can we identify top sessions by token count and evict selectively?
Maria G.: running `top_sessions --pool resv-us-east-3 --sort token_count` -> showing 12 sessions >5000 tokens, all Orchid. Would like to evict the oldest 6.
Sam H.: do it but keep one replication for quick restart. Evict oldest 6.
Maria G.: evicting 6 sessions now -> reclaimed ~3.2GB GPU memory each. Queue continues to drop.
Joel: monitoring latency p50/p95: p50 back to baseline, p95 still elevated at ~2.4x. Can't fully return until autoscale quota increases or we shift partner workloads out.
Arjun P.: infra-quota replied: can provision +8 GPUs in us-east-3 if we deallocate from partner pool 'resv-us-east-3-partner'. Opening ticket to request transient reassign.
Sam H.: do we have permission to preempt partner pool? That could have its own customers. Wait for infra. Meanwhile, push fairness throttles: per-tenant max in-flight to Orchid to 50. Maria, set token-based throttling for Orchid.
Maria G.: setting `tenant_rate_limit[orchidbank]=50` -> applied. Orchid queue reduced growth rate, but their customers will see reduced concurrency.
Kevin (CS): I'll notify Orchid that we're applying temporary concurrency limit to stabilize; offer a callback once we fully restore.
Sam H.: summary for postmortem: root cause is quota boundary combined with noisy long-running sessions from Orchid and background internal evals. Mitigations: aggressive eviction, disable internal jobs, tenant throttling, manual eviction of top KV sessions, request extra region quota. Next steps: infra to reassign GPUs or increase quota, and customer fairness enforcement as safety net.
Kevin (CS): Orchid acknowledged the temporary limit and asked for RFC on future protections. I'll schedule follow-up with account team.
Arjun P.: infra updated: partner agreed to lend 6 GPUs for 40m window. Manual scale applied +6. Queues trending down and p95 improving.
Maria G.: p95 now 1.35x baseline. Queue almost cleared.
Sam H.: closing bridge in 10m, keep monitoring for 1h. Please add timeline to incident ticket.
deploy-bot: incident ticket updated: https://tickets.redwood.internal/INC-6198765432 - status: mitigated - actions: eviction, throttling, job-disable, infra quota borrow
Kevin (CS): Orchid notified, they want postmortem and a plan to prevent recurrence. I'll own customer follow-up.
Maria G.: adding logs/commands to ticket and creating runbook entry for noisy-reserved-tenant mitigation.
Sam H.: thanks team. moving to post-incident review. :thumbsup:
